findings.risk: Data at rest in the Neptune cluster is stored in plaintext. If the underlying storage media is compromised or improperly accessed, sensitive graph data is exposed without any cryptographic protection.
findings.remediation: Set storage_encrypted = true in the aws_neptune_cluster resource. Optionally specify a kms_key_arn pointing to a customer-managed KMS key for stronger key control.

findings.risk: Without IAM authentication, the cluster relies solely on username/password credentials. This increases the risk of credential theft, brute-force attacks, and makes it harder to enforce least-privilege access and audit database logins via IAM policies.
findings.remediation: Set iam_database_authentication_enabled = true in the aws_neptune_cluster resource to enforce IAM-based authentication for all database connections.

findings.issue: Final snapshot skipped on cluster deletion
findings.risk: Setting skip_final_snapshot = true means no snapshot is taken when the cluster is deleted. This can result in permanent, unrecoverable data loss if the cluster is accidentally or maliciously destroyed.
findings.remediation: Set skip_final_snapshot = false and provide a final_snapshot_identifier value so a snapshot is automatically created before the cluster is deleted.

findings.issue: No VPC security group or subnet group specified
findings.risk: Without explicitly assigning vpc_security_group_ids and a neptune_subnet_group_name, the cluster may be placed in the default VPC with default security groups, potentially allowing unintended network access to the Neptune endpoint.
findings.remediation: Add vpc_security_group_ids referencing a restrictive security group that limits inbound access to port 8182 from known sources only, and set neptune_subnet_group_name to a subnet group composed of private subnets.

findings.risk: Without deletion_protection = true, the cluster can be deleted by any principal with sufficient IAM permissions, either accidentally or maliciously, leading to permanent data loss.
findings.remediation: Add deletion_protection = true to the aws_neptune_cluster resource to prevent accidental or unauthorised deletion of the cluster.

findings.risk: Without enabling CloudWatch audit logs, there is no record of queries, connections, or administrative actions performed against the Neptune cluster, hindering incident response and compliance auditing.
findings.remediation: Add an enable_cloudwatch_logs_exports = ["audit"] attribute to the aws_neptune_cluster resource to stream audit logs to CloudWatch Logs.

findings.risk: The manual cluster snapshot inherits the encryption state of the source cluster, which has storage_encrypted = false. An unencrypted snapshot exposes a full copy of the graph data at rest and can be shared or copied without cryptographic protection.
findings.remediation: Enable storage_encrypted = true on the source aws_neptune_cluster resource so that all snapshots derived from it are automatically encrypted. For existing unencrypted snapshots, copy them with encryption enabled using a KMS key.
